A lightweight soothing ampoule designed to support calm, balanced-looking skin while providing fresh hydration. Formulated with Centella Asiatica from Madagascar, it is suited to skin that feels oily, stressed or prone to visible blemishes.

Key Benefits

  • Helps soothe and refresh the skin.
  • Supports balanced-looking skin.
  • Provides lightweight hydration.
  • Helps reduce the look of excess oil.
  • Features Centella Asiatica from Madagascar.
  • Suitable for daily skincare routines.

How to Use

After cleansing and toning, apply an appropriate amount to the face. Gently pat until fully absorbed, then follow with moisturiser.

Suitable For

Combination and oily skin, especially skin concerned with excess sebum, visible blemishes or sensitivity.

Combination skin Oily skin Sensitive skin Visible blemishes
